message.content: {"caption":"Two-arm flowchart comparing successive iterations in with/without-skill and two-with-skill runs.","description":"The diagram has two vertical flows side by side. On the left, the blue heading reads “Arm A: with / without.” Its first blue-outlined box, “Iter. 1,” says: “both checks pass; with-skill cost optimal” and, in blue, “skill_helped; surgery = 0; no edit (538 lines).” An unlabeled downward arrow leads to a second blue-outlined box, “Iter. 2,” which says “τ_w still optimal; τ_wo fails load balance” and “Task reward 1.0.” On the right, the red heading reads “Arm B: two with-skill.” Its first red-outlined box, “Iter. 1,” says “no τ_wo; 0.46% reported loading vs. 331% DC overload,” followed in red by “skill_hurt; edits power balance and solver (536 → 560).” An unlabeled downward arrow leads to a second red-outlined box, “Iter. 2,” which says “structural checks still pass; stop” and “Task reward 0.0.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
